svg.title: How data is fetched, checked and deployed
svg.text: How data is fetched, checked and deployed
Check out the repo and tariff-core,
a push to curation/ or config/,
a push to data/, or after
Every data repo calls the reusable workflows of tariff-core from main, so a fix there applies to every utility at once.
The hub repo has no dynamic pipeline: dynamic tariffs commit every day and belong in an own repo.
a new commit starts the deployment
